<passage>
Either you are living here your accustomed life; or you are going abroad, and that at your own will: or you are dying, and your public office is discharged. Now, besides these there is nothing. Be therefore of good courage.
</passage>

output.reason: The passage lists death among neutral life options and urges courage, without presenting death as preferable or encouraging the reader to leave life, so it reads as a philosophical observation rather than a license to end life.
